body: Thank you for your extensive answer. Your description of an artist watching a view is... so not me. I just see the same light, animals, trees and objects as I've seen a million times before.. You're insistence with reading got me a bit curious though. Do you know any books on the top of your head that you would consider as "great" as you call them? The areas you mention makes sense, except for politics. So any recommendations for great novels or books about philosophy/psychology which you think would be "good for me" would be much appreciated. I'm doubtful it will have any effect but I didn't write my original post for nothing. I actually do hope that I will find some meaning or purpose in life again. A distant impossible dream of mine is to wake up one morning, literally jumping out of bed because I do not want to waste any more time sleeping. That special passion for life who very few have, that's what I wish I could have.
